title: Stable hostname verification result
description: Machine-readable contract emitted by tests/cloud/scripts/stable-hostname-verification.mjs (task 5cb4a8fe, AC5). The harness walks the staging hostname matrix (infra/cloud/hostname-matrix.json) and emits one row per surface covering DNS, HTTPS, and CORS preflight. The verdict is pass when every non-skip row is ok. Dry-run mode emits skip rows for every surface; live mode requires every public surface to be ok. The representative-workflow entry points at staging-workflows.mjs which owns the authenticated body check; the production-blockers list always records the Quinn manual gate until the production CNAMEs land.

schemaVersion.description: Bump when the contract changes incompatibly. Consumers should refuse results with an unknown schemaVersion.

runId.description: Stable per-run identifier. Auto-generated when STAGING_RUN_ID is not bound.

intentCommit.description: Commit SHA the run was supposed to validate. Mirrors staging-workflows.mjs's intentCommit for cross-harness correlation.

mode.description: live mode performs DNS+HTTPS+CORS calls; dry-run mode emits skip rows for every surface and never makes a network call.

matrixPath.description: Path to the matrix file the harness walked. Default is infra/cloud/hostname-matrix.json.

matrixTaskId.description: taskId recorded on the matrix (the matrix's source-of-truth metadata).

surfaces.description: Ordered list of per-surface results. One entry per matrix.surfaces entry, in matrix order. Worker surfaces (publicUrl=false) emit a single skip row whose host is null.

host.description: Stable staging hostname from the matrix; null for worker surfaces.

expected.description: Mirror of host for reviewer convenience.

status.description: ok = all live checks passed. fail = at least one live check failed; verdict will be fail. skip = dry-run mode or worker surface with no public URL.

details.description: Check-specific structured detail. dns/https/cors sub-objects appear in live mode only.

evidence.description: Human-readable summary of what was observed. Redacted (no bearer tokens, no full email addresses).

representativeWorkflow.description: Placeholder for the AC5 representative authenticated workflow check, owned by staging-workflows.mjs. The stable-hostname harness asserts that staging-workflows.mjs's evidence does not include *.fly.dev fallback URLs.

productionBlockers.description: Findings that block the production counterpart. In live mode, the production manual gate is always recorded as a blocker until Quinn registers production CNAMEs. In dry-run mode this is empty because production DNS is not in scope yet.

acceptedLimitations.description: Findings the team has consciously accepted for this run. Required to have owner + rationale + follow-up. Allowed to be non-empty for verdict=pass.

verdict.description: Final verdict. pass requires every non-skip surface row to be ok in live mode, or any state in dry-run mode (dry-run always reports pass because skip is a planned state, not a failure).
